blocks.text: MARAMAG, Bukidnon — Frustration is mounting among sugarcane planters in Bukidnon after disappointing initial sugar recovery readings greeted the early opening of the 2026–2027 milling season, sparking fears of steep financial losses amid soaring production and hauling costs. Truck driver Adong Binalhay, who hauls freshly cut sugarcane, took to social media over the weekend to air dismay over the low sugar per ton cane (PSTC) results recorded during the first week of deliveries—just days after milling operations kicked off on Monday last week, Nov. 9, a full month earlier than the previous crop year.
